mainText: Hello, Verona! At 7 PM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 64 degrees with overcast skies at Fireman's Park. We have a full moon tonight, and while the ISS is passing by, you will not be able to see it due to the clouds. The overnight low will reach 50 degrees with no rain predicted.

The Plan Commission has an agenda for November 4th featuring several projects like Ardent Glen and site plans for 1979 Milky Way. Additionally, tax bill information is available with payments due in two installments starting in January.

There is live music today at Bailey's Run Vineyard and Wisconsin Brewing Company. Tomorrow, check out yoga at Insight Wellness. Plus, mark your calendars for the Main Street Trick or Treat happening on Wednesday.
On October 15th, the Verona Police Department arrested a school bus driver for O W I. The incident occurred near Whalen Road and Fairview Terrace, but no injuries were reported.
Today's flavor of the day at Culver's is Snickers Swirl. The store is currently open and will remain open until 10:00 PM tonight, so there is still plenty of time to stop by for a treat.
